meta.corpus: Slay the Spire V2.3.4 — Act 3 + Act 4 monsters (exact AI transcription)
meta.primarySource: references/sts_lightspeed (MonsterSpecific.cpp is ground truth; disagreements with other sources are listed per-entity under conflicts)

conventions.damage: base damage per hit BEFORE strength/weak/vulnerable/back-attack modifiers; hits = number of hits (null = not an attack)
conventions.asc: keys are ascension thresholds; an entry overrides the listed fields at that ascension level and above
conventions.hp.ascLevel: ascension level at which the asc HP range is used instead of base
conventions.effects.power: lightspeed MonsterStatus / PlayerStatus enum names; 'AddCard:<CARD>:<pile>' means create card copies (pile: discard | drawShuffle | drawTop | masterDeck)
conventions.ai.roll: every Monster::rollMove consumes aiRng.random(99) even when the outcome is forced; bc.noOpRollMove() also consumes one aiRng.random(99) for RNG-stream parity; extra rolls consumed inside getMove are spelled out in ai.spec

ai.firstTurn: roll < 50 -> HARDEN, else NIP (applies to all three Darklings)
ai.spec: NIP damage: miscInfo is rolled once at monster construction with monsterHpRng: asc>=2 ? random(9,13) : random(7,11); NIP deals miscInfo + (asc>=2 ? 2 : 0). getMove(roll): (1) if firstTurn: roll<50 -> HARDEN else NIP. (2) if halfDead -> REINCARNATE. (3) if roll<40: if lastMove != CHOMP and this monster's idx != 1 -> CHOMP; else roll = aiRng.random(40,99) and fall through. (4) if roll<70: if lastMove != HARDEN -> HARDEN; else NIP. (5) else (roll>=70): if not lastTwoMoves(NIP) -> NIP; else recurse the whole getMove with a fresh roll = aiRng.random(0,99). Move handlers: CHOMP -> addToBot RollMove; HARDEN -> gain 12 block (+2 STRENGTH at asc>=17), rollMove immediately; NIP -> addToBot RollMove; REGROW -> does nothing, rollMove immediately; REINCARNATE -> curHp = maxHp/2 (integer), halfDead=false, monstersAlive++, re-gain REGROW power, +1 STRENGTH if player has Philosopher's Stone, rollMove immediately. Death/revive cycle (Monster::die with REGROW power): monstersAlive--; if monstersAlive == 0 -> PLAYER_VICTORY (the whole group can never be simultaneously dead/half-dead: killing the last living Darkling wins even while others are regrowing); otherwise the Darkling clears ALL status effects and strength, sets block 0, becomes halfDead (untargetable) and its move becomes REGROW. It still takes turns while halfDead: next turn executes REGROW (nothing) and rolls -> REINCARNATE (because halfDead); the turn after that it executes REINCARNATE and revives at 50% max HP. Net: revives 2 turns after death (wiki power name: Life Link).
historyRules: CHOMP cannot be used twice in a row
CHOMP is never used by the middle Darkling (spawn idx 1)
HARDEN cannot be used twice in a row
NIP cannot be used three times in a row
while halfDead the rolled move is always REINCARNATE

ai.firstTurn: always SLAM (getMove only ever returns SLAM; called on turn 1)
ai.spec: Fixed pattern SLAM, SLAM, EXPLODE. SLAM handler: attack 9/11; if lastTwoMoves(SLAM) (i.e. this was the second consecutive SLAM) -> setMove EXPLODE else setMove SLAM; noOpRollMove. EXPLODE handler: addToBot DamagePlayer(30) - non-attack damage: blockable and capped by player Intangible but NOT modified by strength/weak/vulnerable/back-attack; then addToBot Suicide(triggerRelics=true) - the Exploder dies (a real death: on-death triggers such as Gremlin Horn fire); noOpRollMove. The in-game EXPLOSIVE power is just the 3-turn countdown display for this fixed pattern; lightspeed does not track a power counter (comment: 'game adds explosive power').
historyRules: explodes on its 3rd turn, always (Attack, Attack, Explode)

ai.firstTurn: always TRANSIENT_ATTACK (only move)
ai.spec: getMove always returns TRANSIENT_ATTACK. Damage at execution = (asc>=2 ? 40 : 30) + 10 * (monsterTurnNumber - 1); turn 1 = 30/40, turn 2 = 40/50, etc. Handler: attack; if FADING == 1 at execution time -> addToBot Suicide(triggerRelics=false) (fades away: hp set to 0 and monstersAlive--, but Monster::die is NOT called - no on-death relic/power triggers; if it was the only monster the player still wins); then noOpRollMove; then decrement FADING by 1. So with Fading 5 it attacks on turns 1-5 and disappears at the end of its 5th turn (6 turns / 6 attacks at asc17+). SHIFTING (on taking unblocked HP loss): loses STRENGTH equal to the HP lost and gains SHACKLED for the same amount; SHACKLED restores that STRENGTH at the end of the monster's own turn - i.e. damaging it during your turn weakens only its next attack this cycle. HP is a fixed 999 at all ascensions and consumes NO monsterHpRng call at init.

conflicts.resolution: Normal

ai.firstTurn: always ROAR
ai.spec: getMove(roll): if firstTurn -> ROAR. else if roll < 50 AND lastMove != NOM -> NOM. else if lastMove != SLAM -> SLAM. else DROOL. NOM hit count at execution = floor((monsterTurnNumber + 1) / 2) = ceil(turn/2) hits of 5 (turn 2 -> 1 hit... turn 3 -> 2 hits, turn 5 -> 3 hits, etc.; damage scales with how long the fight lasts). Handlers: ROAR applies Weak+Frail immediately, rollMove immediately. DROOL buffs immediately, rollMove immediately. SLAM attacks, addToBot RollMove. NOM attacks, then FORCES next move = DROOL (setMove, no AI choice) and noOpRollMove. Consequently the 'roll<50 && last!=NOM' branch is never blocked by history in practice (NOM is always followed by DROOL). HP is a fixed 300 at every ascension (the only enemy whose max HP never scales) and consumes NO monsterHpRng call at init.
historyRules: after NOM the next move is always DROOL (hard-coded)
SLAM cannot be used twice in a row (falls through to DROOL)

ai.firstTurn: no special rule
ai.spec: getMove(roll): useConstrict = (player does NOT have CONSTRICTED) AND lastMove != CONSTRICT AND (asc >= 17 OR roll >= 50). if useConstrict -> CONSTRICT. else if roll < 50 AND not lastTwoMoves(QUICK_TACKLE) -> QUICK_TACKLE. else if not lastTwoMoves(SMASH) -> SMASH. else QUICK_TACKLE. At asc17+ Constrict is used whenever it is legal (regardless of roll); below asc17 it needs roll >= 50. CONSTRICT handler applies the debuff immediately then addToBot RollMove; attacks addToBot RollMove.
historyRules: CONSTRICT never used while the player is already Constricted
CONSTRICT cannot be used twice in a row
QUICK_TACKLE cannot be used three times in a row
SMASH cannot be used three times in a row

ai.firstTurn: roll < 33 -> MULTI_STRIKE; roll < 66 -> FLAIL; else WITHER (~1/3 each)
ai.spec: miscInfo = haveUsedImplant flag. getMove(roll), non-first turn - loop with band re-rolls: (band A, roll<10) if lastMove != STRONG_STRIKE -> STRONG_STRIKE; else roll = aiRng.random(10,99), fall through. (band B, roll<20) if !haveUsedImplant AND lastMove != IMPLANT -> IMPLANT; else if aiRng.randomBoolean(0.1) -> STRONG_STRIKE; else roll = aiRng.random(20,99), fall through. (band C, roll<40) if lastMove != WITHER -> WITHER; else if aiRng.randomBoolean(0.4): roll = aiRng.random(0,19); if that roll < 10 -> STRONG_STRIKE; else if !haveUsedImplant -> IMPLANT; else if aiRng.randomBoolean(0.1) -> STRONG_STRIKE; else roll = aiRng.random(20,99) and CONTINUE loop from band C; else (the 0.4 fails) roll = aiRng.random(40,99), fall through. (band D, roll<70) if lastMove != MULTI_STRIKE -> MULTI_STRIKE; else if aiRng.randomBoolean(0.3) -> FLAIL; else roll = aiRng.random(0,39) and CONTINUE loop from band A. (band E, roll>=70) if lastMove != FLAIL -> FLAIL; else WITHER. Base distribution: STRONG_STRIKE 10%, IMPLANT 10%, WITHER 20%, MULTI_STRIKE 30%, FLAIL 30%. IMPLANT handler: set haveUsedImplant; if player lacks OMAMORI and has DARKSTONE_PERIAPT -> player maxHP +6 immediately; rollMove immediately. The PARASITE curse is added to the master deck when the battle ends (exitBattle): if the player has OMAMORI its counter is consumed instead; the curse is granted once Implant has been used even if the Writhing Mass is later killed. Attack handlers addToBot RollMove (FLAIL also addToBot MonsterGainBlock). REACTIVE power: on each instance of unblocked attack damage, queues intent re-rolls; when they resolve, rollMove is invoked once per hit taken (each consumes aiRng.random(99) and possible band re-rolls; the final result becomes the new intent; the current intent counts as lastMove so a Reactive reroll also cannot repeat it). MALLEABLE: on each unblocked attack-damage instance gains block equal to current Malleable value then value +1; value resets to 3 at end of the monster's turn.
historyRules: no move can be used (or Reactive-rerolled into) twice in a row
IMPLANT can only be used once per combat

wiki conditional table (percent chance of NEXT move given last used move) - Parasite row: after Block ~14%, after Debuff 12.5%, after MultiHit ~14%, after BigHit ~11%; Block row: after Parasite ~33%, after Debuff 37.5%, after MultiHit ~43%, after BigHit ~33%; Debuff row: after Parasite ~22%, after Block ~29%, after MultiHit ~29%, after BigHit ~22%; MultiHit row: after Parasite ~33%, after Block ~43%, after Debuff 37.5%, after BigHit ~33%; BigHit row: after Parasite ~11%, after Block ~14%, after Debuff 12.5%, after MultiHit ~14% (approximations from the reroll cascade above)

ai.firstTurn: no special rule (Count/Glare 50/50)
ai.spec: getMove(roll): if monsterTurnNumber >= 4 at roll time -> IT_IS_TIME (rolls happen during the monster's turn for the NEXT turn, so It Is Time is first USED on turn 5 and repeats forever). else if roll < 50: GLARE unless lastTwoMoves(GLARE) -> then COUNT. else: COUNT unless lastTwoMoves(COUNT) -> then GLARE. IT_IS_TIME damage at execution = (asc>=3 ? 40 : 30) + 5 * min(monsterTurnNumber - 5, 6); first use (turn 5) +0, growing +5 per turn to a cap of +30 -> max 60 (asc3+: 70). Handlers: COUNT attack, addToBot RollMove; GLARE applies Weak immediately, rollMove immediately; IT_IS_TIME attack, forces next move = IT_IS_TIME via noOpRollMove path (the >= 4 turn check makes every subsequent roll return it). SLOW power: starts at 0, +1 per card the player plays; the Giant Head takes (10*X)% more attack damage this turn; resets to 0 at end of each round.
historyRules: GLARE cannot be used three times in a row
COUNT cannot be used three times in a row

ai.firstTurn: roll < 50 -> ATTACK (Tri Attack), else DEBUFF (Tri Burn); never Scythe turn 1
ai.spec: getMove(roll), non-first turn: (roll<30) if SCYTHE not in last two moves -> SCYTHE; else if aiRng.randomBoolean(): ATTACK unless lastTwoMoves(ATTACK) -> then DEBUFF; else (bool false): DEBUFF unless lastMove(DEBUFF) -> then ATTACK. (30<=roll<65) if not lastTwoMoves(ATTACK) -> ATTACK; else if (!aiRng.randomBoolean() OR SCYTHE in last two) -> DEBUFF; else SCYTHE. (roll>=65) if lastMove != DEBUFF -> DEBUFF; else if aiRng.randomBoolean() AND SCYTHE not in last two -> SCYTHE; else ATTACK. Intangible cycle: after executing ANY move, if it does not currently have INTANGIBLE it gains INTANGIBLE 2 (ATTACK/SCYTHE queue the buff via addToBot; DEBUFF buffs immediately). INTANGIBLE decrements at the end of the monster's turn, so: turn 1 not intangible -> gains 2 -> end-of-turn 1; turn 2 intangible (all damage to it capped at 1) -> end-of-turn 0; turn 3 not intangible -> re-gains... i.e. intangible on every even-numbered turn. DEBUFF handler creates the Burns immediately and rolls immediately; attack handlers addToBot RollMove.
historyRules: SCYTHE cannot be used if it was either of the last two moves
DEBUFF (Tri Burn) cannot be used twice in a row
ATTACK (Tri Attack) cannot be used three times in a row
intangible every other turn (gains Intangible 2 after acting on any turn it is not intangible)

ai.firstTurn: always SUMMON (the canSpawn cap is NOT consulted on turn 1: at asc18 this brings the fight to 4 daggers)
ai.spec: getMove(roll): if firstTurn -> SUMMON. Otherwise loop: (roll<33) if lastMove != SNAKE_STRIKE -> SNAKE_STRIKE; else roll = aiRng.random(33,99), fall through. (roll<66) if not lastTwoMoves(SUMMON) AND canSpawn -> SUMMON; else SNAKE_STRIKE. (roll>=66) if lastMove != BIG_BITE -> BIG_BITE; else roll = aiRng.random(0,65) and repeat the loop. canSpawn = bc.monsters.monstersAlive < 4. SUMMON handler: reptomancerSummon(asc>=18 ? 2 : 1): open slots are searched in fixed order [4,1,3,0] (Reptomancer occupies slot 2); each summoned DAGGER is constructed (hp roll 20-25 via monsterHpRng), gets MINION, has its move preset to DAGGER_STAB (no AI roll for the move itself, but bc.noOpRollMove() consumes one aiRng.random(99) per dagger), gains +1 STRENGTH if player has Philosopher's Stone, and SKIPS its turn on the round it was summoned; then Reptomancer rollMove immediately. Attack handlers addToBot RollMove. MINION_LEADER: killing the Reptomancer ends the fight (all Daggers flee).
historyRules: SNAKE_STRIKE cannot be used twice in a row
BIG_BITE cannot be used twice in a row
SUMMON cannot be used three times in a row

ai.firstTurn: phase 1 always opens with SLASH; phase 2 always opens with DARK_ECHO
ai.spec: miscInfo = phase2 flag. getMove(roll): if halfDead -> REBIRTH. PHASE 1 (miscInfo false): if firstTurn -> SLASH. if roll < 25: SOUL_STRIKE unless lastMove(SOUL_STRIKE) -> then SLASH. else: SLASH unless lastTwoMoves(SLASH) -> then SOUL_STRIKE. PHASE 2: if roll < 50: SLUDGE unless lastTwoMoves(SLUDGE) -> then TACKLE; else TACKLE unless lastTwoMoves(TACKLE) -> then SLUDGE. Half-death (Monster::die when phase 1): becomes halfDead (untargetable, keeps taking turns), removes all debuffs (negative STRENGTH set to 0 etc.), removes CURIOSITY, move forced to REBIRTH, the pending card queue is CLEARED (remaining queued player cards this action fizzle). REBIRTH handler (executes on its next turn): maxHp set to (asc>=9 ? 320 : 300), curHp = maxHp (full heal), halfDead = false, phase2 flag set, strength = max(0, strength) (POSITIVE strength - e.g. from Curiosity and the asc4 +2 - is KEPT), monstersAlive++, gains MINION_LEADER (killing it in phase 2 now ends the fight; the two Cultists flee), next move forced DARK_ECHO, noOpRollMove. CURIOSITY (phase 1 only): whenever the player plays a Power card the Awakened One gains 1 (asc19: 2) STRENGTH - see conflicts: lightspeed has this trigger commented out. REGEN 10/15: heals at the end of each of its turns (persists into phase 2). Encounter: 2 Cultists + Awakened One; the Cultists are NOT minions (Fatal etc. triggers work on them).
historyRules: phase 1: SLASH cannot be used three times in a row
phase 1: SOUL_STRIKE cannot be used twice in a row
phase 2: SLUDGE cannot be used three times in a row
phase 2: TACKLE cannot be used three times in a row
while halfDead the rolled move is always REBIRTH

ai.firstTurn: no special rule (normal distribution from turn 1)
ai.spec: miscInfo = usedHaste flag. getMove(roll): if !usedHaste AND curHp < maxHp/2 -> HASTE (the roll was still consumed). (roll<45) REVERBERATE unless lastTwoMoves(REVERBERATE); else roll = aiRng.random(50,99), fall through. (roll<80) HEAD_SLAM unless lastMove(HEAD_SLAM); else if aiRng.randomBoolean(0.66) -> REVERBERATE; else RIPPLE. (roll>=80) if lastMove(RIPPLE): roll = aiRng.random(74); if that roll < 45 -> REVERBERATE else HEAD_SLAM. else RIPPLE. Base distribution ~ Reverberate 45% / Head Slam 35% / Ripple 20%. HASTE handler (once per combat): set usedHaste; curHp = maxHp/2 (integer division - heals UP to exactly half, it only triggers below half); asc19+: gains 32 block; removes its own debuffs (including SHACKLED, so pending strength-restore is lost). RIPPLE handler applies the debuffs immediately and rolls immediately; HASTE rolls immediately; attacks addToBot RollMove. TIME_WARP power (counter starts 0, shown on the boss): whenever the player plays a card (cards whose on-use triggers fire), if the counter is 11 (i.e. this is the 12th card) -> counter resets to 0, Time Eater gains 2 STRENGTH, and the player's turn ENDS immediately; otherwise counter +1. Cards played after the forced end still on the queue are cleared by the end-turn sequence.
historyRules: HASTE is used exactly once, on the first roll after dropping below 50% HP
REVERBERATE cannot be used three times in a row
HEAD_SLAM cannot be used twice in a row
RIPPLE cannot be used twice in a row

ai.firstTurn: aiRng.randomBoolean(): true -> FORTIFY, false -> BASH (50/50; the aiRng.random(99) roll itself is consumed but ignored)
ai.spec: getMove is only consulted at battle init and after SMASH; it ignores the roll value and uses aiRng.randomBoolean(): true -> FORTIFY, false -> BASH. Handlers hard-code the cycle so SMASH lands every 3rd turn (turns 3, 6, 9...): BASH: attack 12/14; if player has any orb slots -> queue SpireShieldDebuff (aiRng.randomBoolean(): true -> player FOCUS -1, false -> player STRENGTH -1), else player STRENGTH -1 immediately; next move = FORTIFY if the move BEFORE this one was SMASH or none (start of a 3-turn block), else SMASH; noOpRollMove. FORTIFY: self +30 block AND Spire Spear (slot 1) +30 block; next move = BASH if move-before was SMASH or none, else SMASH; noOpRollMove. SMASH: damageOutput = fully modified damage (34/38 + strength, x1.5 back-attack if applicable, weak, player vulnerable); attack with it and gain block = that damageOutput (asc18+: flat 99 block instead); addToBot RollMove (-> next 3-turn block starts with the 50/50). Back Attack: prebattle the PLAYER gains SURROUNDED; each attack from this enemy deals x1.5 damage while the player is not facing it - the player faces the monster they last targeted (facing this one also counts if the faced monster is dead/escaped). Spire Shield is in slot 0 (left), Spire Spear slot 1 (right). ARTIFACT 1 (asc18: 2).
historyRules: SMASH every 3rd turn starting turn 3
between Smashes: BASH and FORTIFY once each, in an order chosen 50/50

ai.firstTurn: always BURN_STRIKE
ai.spec: getMove is consulted at battle init (firstTurn -> BURN_STRIKE) and after SKEWER; it ignores the roll value and uses aiRng.randomBoolean(): true -> PIERCER, false -> BURN_STRIKE. Handlers hard-code the cycle so SKEWER lands every 3rd turn (turns 2, 5, 8...): BURN_STRIKE: attack 5x2/6x2; below asc18 add 2 BURN to the discard pile, at asc18+ put 2 BURN on TOP of the draw pile (MakeTempCardInDrawPile(BURN, 2, toBottom=false)); next move = PIERCER if the move BEFORE this one was SKEWER, else SKEWER; noOpRollMove. PIERCER: Spire Shield (slot 0) AND self each gain 2 STRENGTH; next move = BURN_STRIKE if move-before was SKEWER, else SKEWER; noOpRollMove. SKEWER: attack 10 x 3 (asc3+: x4); addToBot RollMove (-> next block's 50/50). Back Attack / Surrounded: same mechanic as Spire Shield (x1.5 when the player is not facing this enemy). ARTIFACT 1 (asc18: 2). Spire Spear is in slot 1 (right side).
historyRules: turn 1 always BURN_STRIKE
SKEWER every 3rd turn starting turn 2
between Skewers: BURN_STRIKE and PIERCER once each, in an order chosen 50/50

ai.firstTurn: always DEBILITATE
ai.spec: getMove(roll): if firstTurn -> DEBILITATE. Otherwise (only reached from DEBILITATE's or BUFF's rollMove - the attacks set their successor directly): the roll value is ignored; aiRng.randomBoolean(): true -> BLOOD_SHOTS, false -> ECHO. Handlers: DEBILITATE applies Vuln 2 / Weak 2 / Frail 2 and shuffles 1 each of DAZED, SLIMED, WOUND, BURN, VOID into the DRAW pile (all immediately), then rollMove. BLOOD_SHOTS: attack 2 x 12 (asc4+: x15); if monsterTurnNumber % 3 == 0 -> next move = BUFF else next = ECHO; noOpRollMove. ECHO: attack 40/45; if monsterTurnNumber % 3 == 0 -> next = BUFF else next = BLOOD_SHOTS; noOpRollMove. BUFF: strength = max(0, strength) + 2 (clears negative strength, then +2); buffCount = monsterTurnNumber / 3 (integer): 1 -> ARTIFACT 2; 2 -> BEAT_OF_DEATH +1; 3 -> PAINFUL_STABS; 4 -> STRENGTH +10; 5 or more -> STRENGTH +50 (every subsequent buff); then rollMove (50/50 attack). Resulting fixed cycle: turn 1 DEBILITATE; turns 2-3 the two attacks in a random order; turn 4 BUFF (Artifact 2); turns 5-6 attacks (random order); turn 7 BUFF (Beat of Death +1); turn 10 BUFF (Painful Stabs); turn 13 BUFF (Strength +10); turn 16, 19, 22... BUFF (Strength +50 each). Note the attack pair alternates: the post-BUFF/DEBILITATE 50/50 picks the first attack, then the handlers force the OTHER attack next turn. Powers: BEAT_OF_DEATH X - the player takes X non-attack (blockable) damage after every card they play; INVINCIBLE X - the Heart can lose at most X HP per turn, and the cap RESETS to 300 (asc19: 200) at the start of each of its turns; PAINFUL_STABS (once gained) - every attack hit from the Heart that makes the player lose HP adds 1 WOUND to the discard pile.
historyRules: turn 1 always DEBILITATE
BUFF every 3rd turn starting turn 4 (set when an attack executes on a turn number divisible by 3)
on non-buff turns the two attacks alternate; after DEBILITATE or BUFF the next attack is chosen 50/50

notes.rngParity: Monster::rollMove always consumes aiRng.random(99); bc.noOpRollMove() consumes one aiRng.random(99); moves that force a successor via setMove typically call noOpRollMove for parity with the real game's rollMove(0..99) call - exceptions that consume NOTHING: DONU and DECA move handlers.
notes.surrounded: calculateDamageToPlayer applies, in order: +strength, x1.5 back-attack (if player SURROUNDED and not facing attacker), x0.75 weak (x0.6 with Paper Krane), x1.5 player vulnerable (x1.25 with Odd Mushroom), x2 wrath, floor, min 1 vs player Intangible, clamp >= 0.
